map.缩写按词组首字或首字母拼接：英文按单词取首字母，并可选择跳过 a/an/the/: The acronym joins the initial character or letter of each word group. For English, take the first letter of each word and optionally skip stop words such as a, an, the, of and and. For Chinese, split on spaces or punctuation, or use the built-in common-word dictionary for longest forward matching and take the first character of each word group (characters not in the dictionary are treated as single characters). Letter case (all uppercase, initial capital, all lowercase) and the separator (none, hyphen, dot) are adjustable. Enter one phrase per line and each result is listed on its own line; for long phrases keep only 3 to 5 letters.

map.「Application Programming Interface」→ 取各词: "Application Programming Interface" takes the initials A, P, I, giving API in uppercase with no separator; "natural language processing" gives NLP.
map.同短语选 kebab 连接 → A-P-I，选小写 → api；含虚词（of/a: The same phrase with a kebab separator gives A-P-I, and with lowercase gives api. Function words (of, and) can be skipped for a shorter acronym, e.g. "Federal Bureau of Investigation" gives FBI (skipping of).
